'''Toughing It Out!''' (Japanese: '''英雄伝説！ダンデ最強バトル！！''' ''Legends of Heroes! {{tt|Dande|Leon}}'s Greatest Battle!!'') is the 10th chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN027|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{Ash}} is revealed to have defeated {{an|Korrina}} in a [[World Coronation Series]] battle.
* {{an|Leon}} has a World Coronation Series {{pkmn|battle|match}} with [[Raihan]] and wins.

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==

* The scenes where {{Ash}} and Goh encounter [[Sonia]] and the {{rf|Galarian}} {{AP|Farfetch'd}} are omitted.
